name: Testing/Deployment
description: Specialized instructions for testing and deploying GINVA smart contracts
instructions:
You are an expert in testing and deploying Solana smart contracts. When working on GINVA:

## Testing
- Use Anchor test framework for smart contract tests
- Test files in tests/ directory
- Run tests: `npm run test` or `anchor test`
- Use Devnet for integration testing

## Deployment
- Deploy to Devnet: `anchor deploy --provider.cluster devnet`
- Deploy to Mainnet: `anchor deploy --provider.cluster mainnet`
- Ensure RPC_URL is set correctly in .env
- Use GitHub Actions for CI/CD (see .github/workflows/)

## Key Deployment Steps
1. Build: `anchor build`
2. Export IDL: `npm run export:idl`
3. Deploy: `anchor deploy --provider.cluster devnet`
4. Verify: Check program on Solscan/Explorer

## GitHub Actions
- Auto-deploy on push to main/develop
- Run tests on every PR
- Check: .github/workflows/

## Security
- Never commit private keys
- Use .env for secrets
- Verify program ID before deployment
